lessons.trigger_condition: V379 validates information exchange and V378 validates the 100+1000 quality policy, but a current mutation can still proceed without computing a decision-specific 100-perspective and 1000-cell matrix over neural, market, evidence, state, resource and exchange signals
lessons.prevention_rule: V380 must preview V379 read-only, compute exactly 100 senior-preparation perspectives and 25x40=1000 review cells for the current decision, use the validated information-exchange neural council when available, treat exchange conflicts/invalid evidence and all safety/evidence/state/provenance blockers as non-outvotable, recheck the exchange digest before mutating V379, and allow runtime self-extension only through the existing allowlisted declarative capability and verified-skill path
validation_required: tablet runtime manifest includes v380 while preserving v379 v378 v377 and v376
each autonomy decision computes exactly 100 senior preparation perspectives
each autonomy decision computes exactly 25 expert groups x 40 review lenses = 1000 cells
review matrices have deterministic SHA-256 digests and lowest-scoring evidence
validated information-exchange neural council participates in the decision gate when available
exchange conflict or invalid exchange evidence cannot be outvoted
exchange input digest is rechecked immediately before mutating V379 and drift fails closed
hard safety evidence state provenance and proposal blockers cannot be outvoted by neural confidence
market freshness hold permits only bounded recovery or observation
runtime self-added behavior remains allowlisted declarative capabilities and verified skills only
source-level new functions remain non-executable proposals requiring protected branch PR CI and full regression
market adaptation remains freshness coverage source-health only and never predicts market direction
peer fixes and peer content are never directly applied or trained into the local model
physical Tablet runtime and Drive readback remain unverified until matching external evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V380 adds current-decision matrix governance on top of V379 exchange governance; it does not create arbitrary source code or commands, write Git/main, weaken verification, invent facts/prices/grades/market direction, auto-apply peer fixes, or claim physical-device success without evidence
